notes: Large-source-unit דֹּרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת → archers reviewed and retained: one English word writes both the drawing and the bow, neither morpheme has a word of its own, so rule 30 fuses and rule 23 heads on the governing construct. מַרְבִּים → had many: the verb is what the have renders (rule 43), headed on many. בְנֵי בָנִים → sons' sons with the rectum as the possessive (rule 29).
